newsitem.title: USA: TALKING POINT/Donna Karan gets discounted.
newsitem.headline: TALKING POINT/Donna Karan gets discounted.

text.p: Fashion designer Donna Karan may have to get out of the beauty business before things turn ugly.
Troubles at the company's beauty unit have dented earnings, sent analysts slashing 1996 and 1997 profit expectations and ultimately helped thrash the one-time glamour stock on Wall Street.
Now, the company says it may shed the sagging unit, which sells fragrances, bath & body products, or consider a joint venture or license.
